tasks.short: Select, prepare, check and separately provide genetics educational materials.

steps.what: Identify the audience and purpose of the genetics-related educational materials
Retrieve current approved genetics information and suitable existing educational materials
Prepare the educational explanation and adapt its wording to the intended audience

loop.purpose: Draft a plain explanation from approved educational sources
loop.input: Audience, topic and selected current sources
loop.output: Draft material with source-linked claims and preserved uncertainty
loop.check: Counselor checks meaning, risk wording, source currency and audience suitability; no individual risk is inferred
loop.stop: One revision; altered risk meaning, unsupported claims or unsuitable wording require manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: An approved leaflet is reused where sufficient; a loop is only for remaining audience-specific explanation

steps.what: Check educational accuracy, uncertainty and readability against the current sources
Check the final version and provide educational materials to the intended recipients

tasks.design: Use controlled source and leaflet views in {DOCS}, with a bounded drafting step only for needed audience-specific wording. Clinical meaning and final review stay human, and providing the exact checked version through {EMAIL} is a separate action.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding current material and adapting explanations require repeated handling and writing.
tasks.enabler_now: Native source organisation and reviewed source-linked drafting can reuse approved explanations.
tasks.still_hard: Preserving the meaning of risk and uncertainty for a particular audience.
tasks.human_edge: Clinical judgement and recognising what the recipient needs to understand.
tasks.altitude: Prepare clear educational material with less repeated source and prose handling.

reach.task: Locate the current source behind an explanation

evidence.claim: Controlled leaflet retrieval and reviewed source-grounded educational drafting are plausible E1 capabilities; no digest case measures this benefit.

assumptions: This task owns standalone educational material and its provision; course-programme modules belong to task 17512 and are not counted again here.

The counselor supplies purpose, topic and audience in s1, verifies source identity and version in s2 and provides recipient identity in s5. Capture and checking effort remain counted; absent or unsuitable sources require manual preparation.
Reuse approved leaflets and native templates before a model loop. No patient genotype, individual risk calculation or clinical recommendation is generated.
Ordinary author saves during preparation and correction remain fully retained without self-approval; the gate binds only the actual provision of the final material.
unknowns: Availability and currency of approved leaflets
Allowed drafting environment and recipient channel
research_questions: Does reviewed audience adaptation save total preparation time while preserving every risk qualifier and source meaning?

already_counted.description: Draft review and full educational accuracy checking

incremental.description: Maintain source versions and drafting quality checks

approvals.approved_version: Exact final educational material, source version and intended recipients checked before provision; any content or audience change voids approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central E1 B100 R84 gives16 gross minus3 upkeep =13 net. Low: current source versions are hard to identify and risk wording needs major rewriting, leaving retrieval19 and writing27 plus50 unchanged, R96; net1. High: approved sources fit the topic but audience wording needs editing, leaving17+22+50=89 retained; net8 after3 upkeep. Purpose selection, full accuracy checking and actual provision remain full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Evaluate standards and operations, write recommendations and communicate the final advice.

steps.what: Retrieve relevant standards of care, regulations, ethics guidance and current operating documents
Evaluate current clinical operations against applicable standards and ethical requirements
Discuss operational constraints and clarify proposed changes with clinical colleagues
Write and check recommendations for standards of care or clinical operations

loop.purpose: Draft the counselor's recommendation with traceable supporting sources
loop.input: Professional evaluation, selected priorities and current sources
loop.output: Draft recommendation separating observations, interpretation and proposed change
loop.check: Counselor checks every normative claim, clinical implication and source reference
loop.stop: One revision; unresolved interpretation or conflicting requirements return the text to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: A recommendation template cannot express the case-specific clinical and ethical rationale

steps.what: Check the final recommendation and communicate it to the responsible clinical committee

tasks.design: Configure current-source views in {DOCS} and a bounded draft of recommendations from the counselor's evaluation. Clinical and ethical interpretation stays human; writing the recommendation and communicating its final version through {EMAIL} are separate steps, without granting policy-enactment authority.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reference navigation and first-draft rationale add effort around professional evaluation.
tasks.enabler_now: Versioned source links and reviewed drafting can reuse the selected rationale.
tasks.still_hard: Interpreting conflicting obligations and deciding clinically appropriate operational changes.
tasks.human_edge: Accountable clinical and ethical judgement with knowledge of local operations.
tasks.altitude: Spend more preparation attention on the substance of clinical operations recommendations.

reach.task: Trace the rationale behind a proposed change

evidence.claim: Native standards retrieval and reviewed recommendation drafting are E1 capabilities; no supplied case validates automated clinical compliance judgement.

assumptions: The task includes the actual recommendation document and internal handoff. Committee enactment of policy is not a hidden machine action or extra approval stage.

The counselor identifies topic and source versions in s1, evaluates operational evidence in s2 and supplies the chosen rationale in s3-s4. Capture time remains counted; conflicting or missing sources require manual analysis.
Native controlled-document views and recommendation templates precede a loop. No automatic legal determination, clinical recommendation selection or policy publication is proposed.
Ordinary author saves during writing remain fully retained without self-approval; the gate concerns the exact internal communication.
research_questions: Does source-linked drafting reduce recommendation writing time after checking clinical implications and normative meaning?

already_counted.description: Full professional evaluation and recommendation draft review

incremental.description: Maintain controlled source links and drafting checks

approvals.approved_version: Exact final recommendation, supporting references and committee recipients checked before communication; any change requires a fresh check.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central E1 B100 R86 gives14 gross minus3 upkeep =11 net. Low: overlapping local policies require full manual comparison and draft rationale is mostly rewritten, leaving retrieval19 and writing22 plus55 unchanged, R96; net1. High: controlled references are identifiable but clinical implications still need substantial edits, leaving17+18+55=90 retained; net7 after3 upkeep. Evaluation, consultation and actual communication remain full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Conduct approved genetics research and separately capture and maintain the study record.

steps.what: Define the genetics research question and follow the approved study method
Retrieve relevant literature and authorised study source records
Conduct the research observations, interviews or authorised record review
Record study observations and source references in the research dataset
Analyse the recorded information and interpret research limitations and findings
Write the working findings and maintain source-linked study notes

tasks.design: Configure source-linked study forms in {OTHER}, the research data capture system, and working findings layouts in {DOCS}. Research activity, observation capture, analysis and writing are separate phases; native structures reduce repeated metadata and layout while preserving research interpretation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Study identifiers, source references and working-note structures are repeatedly entered.
tasks.enabler_now: Native capture forms and linked research documents can reuse stable study fields.
tasks.still_hard: Sound research methods, ambiguous evidence and interpretation of findings.
tasks.human_edge: Scientific judgement and understanding the clinical context of the evidence.
tasks.altitude: Maintain traceable research records with less repeated handling.

reach.task: Trace an observation to its source

evidence.claim: Native study capture forms and source-linked notes may reduce metadata entry; benefit is E1 rather than a measured genetics research case.
Genetic and health information requires special-category data handling; the proposed forms do not create new permission to reuse it.

assumptions: The task includes research activity, actual observation entry and working findings writing. Existing protocol and permissions are inputs, not invented extra approval work.

The counselor identifies the study in s1, verifies source records in s2 and captures participant or source code, encounter date, observation and source reference in s4 from s3. Capture time is counted; missing data remain explicit manual exceptions.
Native capture forms and templates are tested before code. No participant inference, automated diagnosis, new data collection feed or external report send is implied.
Ordinary author saves remain fully retained without self-approval. Existing analytical software runtime receives no saving.
unknowns: Study type and permitted source reuse
Native research capture features and existing metadata
research_questions: Which repeated study fields can native forms reuse without additional source verification or data cleaning?

already_counted.description: Full research activity and scientific interpretation

incremental.description: Maintain study form definitions and source links

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central E1 B100 R91 gives9 gross minus2 upkeep =7 net. Low: sources use incompatible participant codes and observations are mostly narrative, leaving retrieval15, capture19 and notes4 plus60 unchanged, R98; net0. High: study identifiers align but observation text remains personal, leaving13+17+4+60=94 retained; net4 after2 upkeep. Research conduct and interpretation stay full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Design genetics training, prepare materials, organise participants and conduct the programme.

steps.what: Design the genetics training objectives and sequence for the intended audience
Retrieve current genetics references and suitable existing teaching examples
Write and check the programme teaching materials and learning exercises

loop.purpose: Draft programme-specific teaching explanations and exercises
loop.input: Training objectives, audience level and verified source examples
loop.output: Draft training sections and exercises with source links
loop.check: Counselor checks genetics accuracy, uncertainty, audience level and learning purpose
loop.stop: One revision pass; inaccurate examples or unsupported explanations require manual preparation
loop.why_not_simpler: A slide template cannot adapt explanations and exercises to a specific training audience

steps.what: Enter participant registrations, session details and the planned training notice
Check the final session notice and send it to registered participants
Check and conduct genetics training with explanations, exercises and responsive discussion
Record attendance, programme feedback and revisions needed after training
outputs: updated attendance and programme review notes

tasks.design: Use native programme and register layouts in {DOCS} and {LMS}, with bounded source-grounded drafting for teaching material. Pre-training registration and the notice through {EMAIL}, live training and post-training attendance and review entry are separate lifecycle steps.
tasks.previous_blocker: Material writing and repeated programme and participant fields add effort around training.
tasks.enabler_now: Native templates and checked drafting can reuse programme structures and verified examples.
tasks.still_hard: Teaching complex genetics accurately to audiences with different needs.
tasks.human_edge: Clinical expertise and responsive explanation during discussion.

ambition.what: Use verified preparation capacity for an introductory community training session.

tasks.altitude: Prepare reusable programme structures while keeping training clinically accountable.

reach.task: Maintain clear session and attendance records

evidence.claim: Native training forms and reviewed programme drafting are plausible E1 capabilities; the digest provides no measured genetics training time result.

assumptions: This task owns programme-specific design, modules and delivery. Standalone patient leaflets are owned by task 17518, so their initial production is not counted again.

The counselor supplies objectives and audience in s1 and verifies sources in s2. Participant registration supplies identity and contact; the counselor captures these plus session identity, time and location in s4, and actual attendance and feedback in s7. Capture time is counted; missing fields are clarified manually.
Native programme templates and existing examples precede the drafting loop. No automatic enrolment, notification or certification is implied.
Ordinary author saves in preparation and later records stay fully retained without self-approval. The optional new community session is additional demand outside baseline saving.
unknowns: Whether the counselor performs all programme administration
research_questions: Does reviewed module drafting reduce preparation after checking every example and recording actual participant outcomes?

already_counted.description: Teaching-material review and participant record entry

incremental.description: Maintain programme templates, sources and drafting checks

approvals.approved_version: Exact session notice, dates, location and registered recipients checked immediately before sending; changes void approval.
Exact final teaching material, examples and participant audience checked before delivery; changed clinical explanations require a new check.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central E1 B100 R84 gives16 gross minus3 upkeep =13 net. Low: audience-specific exercises need major rewriting and registration metadata are inconsistent, leaving sources10, material22, registration9 and outcomes10 plus45 unchanged, R96; net1. High: verified examples fit and participant identifiers align but explanation edits remain, leaving9+19+8+8+45=89 retained; net8 after3 upkeep. Programme design, notice send and delivery stay full.
